description: Radar domains and their momentum normalisation. AI keeps the production absolute rules (output unchanged by construction). ENGINEERING uses the hybrid chosen in docs/PHASE-6.3-MOMENTUM-VALIDATION.md: a repository is flagged when its 30-day growth is in the top 2% of the Engineering population or in the top 3% of its size band, with absolute floors, the production acceleration test and a single-day-spike guard. Size-band bounds are the rounded empirical terciles of the Engineering star distribution (1,133-1,275 and 5,713-6,007 over the replay window).
